signals.description: A claim requires verification before it can be treated as established.
Current reasoning or implementation approach is not working.
The constraints of the task have shifted from what was originally established.
A user report of current observable behavior conflicts with a prior agent conclusion or verified state.
A completion claim materially rests on edit existence, an implementation-mirroring test, or rereading newly written code.
A proposed edit adds another distinct responsibility to an already multi-responsibility unit.
Tool execution has exceeded retry bounds without success.
A tool result is being interpreted more broadly than it warrants.
An earlier observation or passing test is relied on after a newer contradictory report without fresh inspection.
The produced artifact concentrates responsibility in one owner beyond its scope.
The produced code creates measurable operational friction or load.
An action carries authority, permission, or scope risk.
An action would expose or transmit secrets.
ANCHOR has initiated a recovery procedure.
An action requires user confirmation before proceeding.
The produced artifact amplifies the impact of a small change across a wide surface.
